foi-1734722-amateur-call-signs.csv.contentsIndicative: header Value,Status,Product,Type,Call Sign MMSI: Last Modified Date (leading UTF-8 BOM, CRLF, UTF-8); 153,938 data rows - 101,947 Allocated, 51,533 Reserved, 447 Available, 11 blank statuses. This is the COMPLETE register: ~45k more rows than the December lists because it carries the full reserved pool (44,860 rows have a blank Product, almost all Reserved). Product vocabulary is the five Amateur products plus three 'Special Event Station' rows (G4ZUL, G6DGK, M0MBB). Type is 'Call Sign - Amateur' throughout. Last-modified dates day-first DD/MM/YYYY spanning 2016-07-23..2023-12-19 (day-first verified: 66,117 rows carry a day>12). Anomalies preserved verbatim: the NBSP trio 2E1HON/G0TQK/G7IWE (trailing non-breaking space, trimmed-and-counted at normalise time); the W-prefix callsign W4WNZ in the reserved pool; 'G6 FMU' interior space; lower-case 'g0jrk'; a ten-character and several seven-to-nine-character reciprocal/regional callsigns.

normalised--foi-1734722-amateur-call-sig.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class,last_modified_date; 153,938 rows sorted by callsign (source order carries no meaning). Status and licence_class (from Product) carried verbatim - 44,860 blank licence_class values (the reserved pool) and 11 blank statuses preserved. last_modified_date ISO-rendered from the day-first source. Type is required-present but not carried. The NBSP trio is trimmed (the sole canonicalisation, counted at convert time) and passes through as 2E1HON/G0TQK/G7IWE.
